title: Console Visual Grammar Stewardship and Component Retirement Playbook
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a stewardship playbook for the Console visual grammar that documents component retirement rules, token deprecation mapping, and a Figma library cleanup plan. This ticket captures an audit of visual divergence across Console surfaces (dashboards, rollout rails, cost widgets), a prioritized list of components for consolidation or retirement, token fallback maps, and the operational steps for migrating product teams with minimal disruption. Deliverables: audit spreadsheet, Figma library update, migration checklist, dev acceptance criteria, and rollout communication templates.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Maya Thompson: Kickoff meeting notes added. Goals aligned with PM/Eng: reduce token variants, consolidate three redundant metric-card components, and establish deprecation cadence (quarterly). Action: run global component usage audit and export Figma instances.

2026-02-24 - Ava Patel: Completed visual audit of 46 Console screens. Findings: 18 components with >3 visual variants; most variance in spacing tokens and status color ramps. Attached audit CSV to Confluence. Recommendation: immediate consolidation candidates: metric-card-compact, metric-card-expanded, metric-sparkline-legacy.

2026-02-26 - Engineering review (Noah Chen): Confirmed technical constraints for retiring metric-card-compact: several legacy routes depend on server-side rendering. Proposed migration window of 8 weeks and a feature flag for gradual rollout. Also requested dev acceptance criteria for accessibility contrast checks.

2026-03-04 - Accessibility review (Sofia Martinez): Performed contrast and focus-order checks on consolidated components. Two tokens (accent-300 and accent-400) fail AA for large text in dark mode. Action: propose adjusted ramps and add to token-change PR. Marked accessibility gate as required before final retirement.

2026-03-08 - Design review (Cross-functional): Reviewed proposed token deprecation map and fallback strategy. Decided on a 3-stage deprecation: aliasing -> opt-in flag -> hard removal. Documented fallback mapping for 14 deprecated tokens to target tokens and included CSS variable example in Figma notes.

2026-03-10 - PM sign-off (Owen Lee): Approved release window and communications plan. PM asks to tie migration progress to Console rollout dashboards and add a customer-facing note for Dedicated/Private customers with upgrade steps.

2026-03-12 - Ava Patel: PR created to update Figma library and publish new component variants. Open items: finalize token ramp adjustments (accessibility), schedule dev spike for SSR routes, and prepare migration runbook for Solutions Eng. Marking ticket In Review pending PR feedback.

Reviewer feedback (2026-03-12) - Engineering: request a detailed list of affected routes and estimated code changes per service. Design: add explicit before/after screenshots for metric-card states across density modes. Accessibility: request automated contrast test in CI.
Follow-up actions: create ENG sub-issue for SSR migration (ENG-274321), create PM checklist item for customer comms (PM-1482), and schedule a 30-minute sync with Solutions Eng.
Decision log: commit to quarterly visual grammar audits, public change log for breaking token removals, and maintain a token alias layer for 6 months after aliasing.
Post-merge: update Console docs and add migration widget to Admin > Rollouts to monitor adoption of new components.
